description_en: Queries the data parsing settings for a specified category
description_zh: 查询指定类目的数据解析设置
name: GetParseSettings

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to which the file belongs. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html. This field is in the request path and must be provided when you call this operation. The bailian 2023-12-29 version does not provide an API for listing workspaces. Obtain the workspace ID from the Model Studio console before calling this operation
parameters.help_zh: 文件所属的业务空间 ID。获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html。该字段位于请求路径中，实际调用时必须提供；bailian 2023-12-29 当前未提供用于枚举业务空间的 API，调用前需在百炼控制台获取业务空间 ID
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The category ID, which is the `CategoryId` returned by the AddCategory operation. You can also obtain it from the <props="china">Application Data (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/data-center) - File tab</props><props="intl">Application Data (https://bailian.console.alibabacloud.com/?tab=app#/data-center) - Unstructured Data tab</props> by clicking the ID icon next to the category name
parameters.help_zh: 类目 ID，即 AddCategory 接口返回的`CategoryId`，或者在<props="china">应用数据 (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/data-center)-文件页签</props><props="intl">应用数据 (https://bailian.console.alibabacloud.com/?tab=app#/data-center)-非结构化数据页签</props>，单击类目名称旁的 ID 图标获取
parameters.name: category_id

Data.description_en: The business data returned when the request is successful
Data.description_zh: 请求成功返回的业务数据

items.description_en: The details of the returned content

FileType.description_en: The file type, specified as a file extension. Valid values include pdf, docx, and doc. All file types supported in the current category are listed
FileType.description_zh: 文件类型，扩展名，可能值为： pdf、docx、doc等，列举当前类目中支持的所有文件类型

Parser.description_en:
The parser used to parse files of the current type under this category. Valid values:
DOCMIND: Intelligent Document Parsing.
DOCMIND_DIGITAL: Electronic Document Parsing.
DOCMIND_LLM_VERSION: LLM-based Document Parsing.
DASH_QWEN_VL_PARSER: Qwen VL Parsing
Parser.description_zh:
解析该类目下当前类型文件使用的解析器。可能值为：
DOCMIND：智能文档解析
DOCMIND_DIGITAL：电子文档解析
DOCMIND_LLM_VERSION：大模型文档解析
DASH_QWEN_VL_PARSER：Qwen VL解析

ParserConfig.description_en: The parser configuration. This parameter is returned only when the type is set to Qwen VL parsing
ParserConfig.description_zh: 解析器配置，仅在类型被设置为Qwen VL解析时才会返回

ModelPrompt.description_en: The prompt used when calling Qwen VL parsing
ModelPrompt.example:
#角色
你是一个专业的图片内容标注人员，擅长识别并描述出图片中的内容。
# 任务目标
请结合输入图片，详细描述图片中的内容。

ParserDisplayName.description_en: The display name of the parsing method

Message.example: workspace id is null or invalid.

Status.description_en: The status code returned by the operation

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功，可能值为：
true：成功 。
false：失败
